Act as the implementation sub-agent for this task.

Finish GitHub issue #235 in Moneo: explicit time-zone parameters and deterministic finance clocks. Meet every acceptance criterion in the issue, including running the suite under both TZ=UTC and TZ=Europe/Berlin.

## RESUME: most of the work is already done
The previous agent crashed (API error) while running typecheck. Its uncommitted changes are in the worktree `C:/Users/mgsuk/.t3/worktrees/Moneo/t3-1cee99a2-6c194efe260290ed` (branch `t3/issue-235-time-zones`). They touch lib/settings.ts, lib/auth.ts, lib/finance/calendar.ts, balances, review, recurring-occurrences, spending-plans, lib/import/csv.ts and row.ts, workflows/bank-sync.ts, app/settings/form.tsx, eslint.config.mjs, AGENTS.md and their tests. That agent already merged in the earlier work from `t3/required-time-zone`.
1. Read it read-only: `git -C <path> diff` and `git -C <path> status`.
2. Bring it into your own checkout: `git -C <path> diff HEAD > <scratch>/235.patch`, then `git apply --3way` onto a branch `t3/issue-235-tz` from current `origin/main` (main has moved: PRs #247, #248 and #249 merged). Copy any untracked files too. Never modify, reset or delete the old worktree.
3. **Commit right away** once the patch applies, so it can't be lost again, and commit after each later step.
4. Continue: get typecheck, lint and tests green, then verify against the issue's criteria.

## Rules
- Read AGENTS.md first and follow it exactly. Read `gh issue view 235 --comments`.
- End each commit message with:
  Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
- Other agents share the moneo-qa backend and QA port 3100:
  - never `npm run qa:reset`, never `docker compose -p moneo-qa down`;
  - never touch the owner's backend (.env, port 3000, project `moneo`);
  - if 3100 is busy, wait and retry, and never kill a process you didn't start.
- If `npm ci` stalls, retry once with `--prefer-offline`.
- `lib/cron.test.ts` times out under load and is being fixed separately (#246). Report that timeout, but don't change it.
- If you add a migration, give it a unique timestamp prefix later than `202611160041`.
- Before finishing:
  - `npm test` under both TZ=UTC and TZ=Europe/Berlin;
  - `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build`;
  - the verify-ui skill for the Settings change. Upload screenshots to the PR if you can (`.qa/` is git-ignored); if you can't, say so.
- Push and open a PR to `main` (`Closes #235`), ending the body with:
  🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
  Never merge.
- Final line: PR <full URL>, head <SHA>, checks and reviews <state>.

Finish explicit time-zone parameters and deterministic finance clocks
Parent tracker: #224

**Priority:** P1 (correctness, security or verification priority).

## Problem and current evidence

Work is already present but uncommitted on t3/required-time-zone. The interrupted run reported three UTC failures. Inspect and preserve that work before implementing anything. The original audit found eight Berlin defaults and 18 direct clock reads; remeasure current code.

## Scope

Finish propagating the owner's Settings time zone through calculations, imports, bank observations, recurring occurrences, reviews and spending plans. Inject the current instant at calculation boundaries where needed. Resolve test fixtures and mock gaps by specifying the intended time zone, without changing expected financial results merely to pass.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No library calculation silently defaults to Europe/Berlin.
- [ ] Calendar dates and day boundaries are correct across DST and UTC-midnight boundaries.
- [ ] Source and desktop Settings detect and persist the device time zone as intended.
- [ ] UTC and Europe/Berlin test runs both pass with deterministic inputs.
- [ ] The interrupted failures are reproduced, diagnosed and resolved; npm test, lint, typecheck and build pass.

## Verification and constraints

Reproduce the current behaviour before changing it. Run the smallest relevant check during implementation, then npm test, npm run lint and npm run typecheck; add a build for app/config changes and real QA browser verification for changed user flows. Use only disposable moneo-qa services, synthetic records and mocked paid integrations. Verify source installation and desktop compatibility. Preserve financial history, corrections and undo. Do not add prose or comments in place of a deterministic boundary.

## Delivery

This issue records follow-up work; it does not claim the change is implemented. Recheck current main and #224 before starting, since the audit counts may have changed. Keep the PR focused and link its checks and relevant evidence here.

## Verification update — 2026-11-15

The historical three UTC failures did not reproduce. A focused UTC run of ten finance/bank/previously timed-out files passed all 69 tests. Lint and typecheck pass. Full-suite verification is still blocked by the reproducible-in-suite cron timeout tracked in #246 (1,713 tests passed on the latest run). The time-zone changes are still uncommitted and are not marked complete. Build and real Settings QA evidence must be completed before closing this issue.

## Latest verification — 2026-11-15

npm run build passes. The six focused finance/bank files also pass under Europe/Berlin (63 tests), in addition to the UTC focused run. Settings browser verification, database checks and desktop build were not run in this issue-filing pass; #246 still prevents a fully green unit suite.
